exp.description: Filter to a specific expiration date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to return the nearest max_expirations dates.

max_expirations.description: Maximum number of expiration dates to include when no specific exp is set. Default 4, max 12.

near_atm_only.description: If true, only return strikes within 20% of the current underlying price. Default false.

ticker.description: US equity or index ticker. Examples: AAPL, SPY, QQQ, TSLA, NVDA.

type.description: Filter by option type. Omit to return both calls and puts.

Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. CBOE delayed options chain for any US equity or index — returns stock price, per-contract IV, greeks (delta/gamma/theta/vega), OI, volume, and bid/ask. Filterable by expiration date and call/put. Free CBOE data, no API key.
